description: 8 1/2% 5-year 2-month note issued 1990-03-01 due 1995-05-15, first payment 1990-11-15 (long first coupon), priced at 8.53% on issue.

reference.version: 31 CFR 356 App. B, current eCFR text as of 2026-10-26
reference.convention: Treasury non-indexed note/bond: actual/actual (ICMA-equivalent) semi-annual accrual; price per 100 rounded to six places; fractional first period discounted at simple interest [1 + (r/s)(i/2)]
reference.source: 31 CFR Part 356, Appendix B, Section II (via law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/31/appendix-B_to_part_356), Section II.C

_long.reason: Long first coupon not supported: V1 schedules only produce a short front stub, paid on its own date instead of folded into the first regular coupon.
